screening_decisions.reason: Animal study (mice), not human RCT. Also uses heparanase, not hyaluronic acid.
Bovine (cow) embryo study, not human. Also focuses on culture medium, not transfer medium.
Matched controlled study, not a truly randomised controlled trial. Allocation was by matching, not randomisation.
Randomised controlled trial comparing HA-enriched embryo transfer medium vs routine medium without HA in human IVF patients.
Prospective randomised controlled trial comparing hyaluronan-enriched transfer medium vs conventional transfer medium in human IVF.
Study focuses on freezing protocol parameters, not comparison of adherence compounds in transfer media. Not an RCT comparing transfer media.
Basic science animal study (mouse uteri), not a clinical RCT in humans.
Prospective randomised clinical trial comparing EmbryoGlue (HA-enriched) vs no treatment in human IVF/ICSI cycles.
Observational basic science study examining CD44 expression, not an RCT comparing transfer media.
Case-control study, not randomised. Also uses fibrin sealant, not hyaluronic acid/adherence compounds.
Preliminary experience report, not an RCT. Uses fibrin sealant, not HA.
Review article summarising other studies, not a primary RCT.
Basic science laboratory study on protein binding, not a clinical RCT.
Cochrane review protocol/article, not a primary RCT.
RCT comparing albumin sources (HSA vs rHA), not adherence compounds in transfer media.
Retrospective observational study, not an RCT.
Observational study, explicitly states 'observational study' in DESIGN section, not randomised.
Bovine embryo study, not human. Also focuses on culture medium, not transfer medium.
Prospective randomised double-blind study comparing HA-only transfer medium vs SSS-containing medium in human IVF.
RCT comparing culture media (HTF vs G5), not transfer media with adherence compounds.
Methodological review of trial quality, not a primary RCT.
Quasi-randomised (alternating weekdays), not truly randomised. Also compares culture media, not transfer media.
RCT but uses fibrin sealant, not hyaluronic acid/adherence compounds.
Case-control study, not randomised controlled trial.
Compares culture media, not transfer media with adherence compounds.
Mouse embryo study, not human clinical trial.
Bovine in vitro study on gene expression and enzyme function, not human RCT on transfer media.
Randomised study comparing HA transfer medium vs albumin transfer medium in human IVF.
RCT comparing number of embryos transferred (1 vs 2), not adherence compounds in transfer media.
Abstract only, insufficient information to confirm RCT status. Appears to be a summary/conclusion statement.
Observational histochemical study, not an RCT.
RCT but compares low HA vs high HA concentrations; both groups contain adherence compounds. Does not compare to no/low adherence compound control.
Prospective randomised clinical trial comparing HA-enriched transfer medium vs conventional transfer medium in human IVF.
Basic science study on CD44 expression, not an RCT comparing transfer media.
Randomised study comparing HETM (0.5 mg/ml HA) vs control medium with no HA in patients with multiple failed transfers.
Abstract truncated/incomplete. Study appears to focus on viscosity rather than adherence compounds specifically. Insufficient information.
RCT on oocyte denudation technique, not on embryo transfer media with adherence compounds.
